snippet.title: Why Gen Z Is Rethinking Marriage
snippet.description:
For generations, marriage was considered a key part of the American Dream. But that trend is quickly changing for younger Americans, especially women. Just 33% of Gen Z women say marriage is integral to achieving the American Dream, compared with 43% of Gen Z men. Marriage rates have declined sharply over the last few decades. 64% of 25-year-olds were married in 1980, compared with 21% in 2024, according to the Pew Research Center. While marriage may still be associated with greater wealth and happiness. For many younger Americans, those potential benefits aren’t enough to make marriage an immediate priority.

🎲 NEED SUPPORT FOR A GAMBLING PROBLEM?

* THE NATIONAL COUNCIL ON PROBLEM GAMBLING – If you or someone you know is struggling with a gambling problem, help is available. The National Council on Problem Gambling provides a range of resources, including answers to commonly asked questions, a gambling behavior self assessment, and information about treatment. It’s completely free, 100% anonymous, and available 24/7.
🌐 Website: https://www.ncpgambling.org/help-treatment/ 
📲 Call or Text: 1-800-MY-RESET
💬 Chat: https://www.ncpgambling.org/chat/ 

* GAMBLERS ANONYMOUS – If you think you may have a gambling problem, Gamblers Anonymous is here to help. There are no dues or fees, and you’ll be welcomed at any meeting. You don’t have to rely on willpower alone—support is available when you’re ready to ask for it.
🌐 Website: https://gamblersanonymous.org/ 
📍 Find a Meeting: https://gamblersanonymous.org/find-a-meeting/ 

* GAM-ANON – Are you concerned about how a loved one’s gambling is affecting your life? Gam-Anon is a support group for spouses, partners, relatives, and close friends of compulsive gamblers. The program helps people better understand gambling addiction, find support from others facing similar challenges, and begin rebuilding their lives.
🌐 Website: https://gam-anon.org/ 
📍 Find a Meeting: https://gam-anon.org/meeting-directory
